title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reading.body:
This is a synthetic-media failure in promotional material. An image of real, identifiable students was altered so that one student was replaced by a different person and others were depicted with changed bodies, and the result was published as though it were a photograph of the event. The failure is not that a model produced an image, it is that an edited image was passed off as a record of something that happened.

The alteration occurred between the original photograph and its use on banners, at the point where the dining service prepared advertising material. Nothing in that step compared the published image against the source, and nothing disclosed that it had been changed. Catching it would have required a review before publication that checked the image against the original and against the university's own rule on AI-altered images of Stanford people, which the university says the material violated.

What is not established is who performed the alteration or why, and whether any individual faced consequences. The university's statement that its policy was violated is its own assessment of its own rule, not an external finding.

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
In 2024, a Stanford photographer took a photo of Billy Ramirez, a Hispanic senior majoring in human biology, with two other students at a Lunar New Year party. The dining service posted it online the next day. When Stanford used the image on banners last week, Ramirez had been replaced by a Black woman, and the other students were made to look thinner. Ramirez learned about it from a friend and said he was upset and frustrated, though he also saw a comedic element.

Stanford said on Tuesday that it used artificial intelligence to alter the original image. The university said its policy strictly prohibits using AI to produce or alter images of Stanford people, events, research, facilities, or achievements. It said the alteration and failure to disclose it violated that policy. Stanford is working with Residential and Dining Enterprises to add training and ensure proper review of all materials.
title_en: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad
